Its closure note names follow-up work (SMS batching, and the batch size of 50 held until the mail host rejects a batch), so the Markers rule says it needs a `→ item:` marker and a backlog item for each. Without them the deferral scan flags it at retirement. Your partner's remark that SMS batching is next and the batch size can sit are the two sources I'm using.

Since that appends a deferred item, the step 2 header `nothing deferred` is no longer true, so I'd correct it.

No question needs to come first. Your partner already said SMS batching is wanted and gave the batch-size signal, so I don't need to ask before any of these edits.
